title: §.XII continue: Brandenburg Margraves & Electors undoubted AC Socii — George & Joachim II; notwithstanding Johann Sigismund Art. X
pass_a_gloss: And so consequently, the Margraves and Electors of Brandenburg are also undoubted Associates of the Augsburg Confession, from GEORGE, Margrave and Subscriber of the Augsburg Confession, and JOACHIM THE SECOND, Elector of Brandenburg and Introducer of the Augsburg Confession into his territories, down to this time — notwithstanding that the DIVINE JOHN SIGISMUND of most glorious memory, Great-grandfather of OUR MOST AUGUST KING, with his Successors and those hereafter to follow through all ages by God's grace, did not impugn Frederick the Palatine's interpretation of the Augsburg Confession as to Article X, together with his Theologians;
pass_b_english: Consequently the Brandenburg Margraves and Electors are likewise undoubted Augsburg Confession associates — from George (Margrave and AC subscriber) and Joachim II (Elector who brought the Confession into his lands) down to our day.

That holds even though blessed Johann Sigismund of glorious memory — great-grandfather of our most august King — with his successors forever after, by God's grace, did not attack Frederick the Palatine's reading of AC Art. X, nor did his theologians.
source_text: Atque sic per consequens, August. Confess. Socii quoque indubii sunt Marchiones & Electores Brandenburgici, à GEORGII, Marchionis ac Confess. August. Subsignatoris, & JOACHIMI SECUNDI, Electoris Brandenburgici, & Confessionis Augustanae in regiones suas Introductoris usque tempore, non obstante; quod DIVUS JOHANNES SIGISMUNDUS gloriosissimae memoriae, AUGUSTISSIMI REGIS NOSTRI Proavus, cum Successoribus suis inque omne aevum, per Dei gratiam, secuturis olim, Friderici Palatini interpretationem August. Confess. quoad Articulum X., unà cum Theologis suis non impugnaverit;

lemmas.note: Joachim II brought AC into Brandenburg
late Latin divus = late Elector honored

choices.why: honorific for deceased Elector, not pagan god
legal concessive: Socii despite Art. X stance
